text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of Tracen
Academy's
annual summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I used to attend a beachside summer
camp with the other students at my
family's dojo, so being
here feels
vaguely nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan and Sakura Chiyono O, who are
both recovering from injuries,
make their way
over to greet Yaeno
Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O! Ardan! You're here for
summer
camp?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, we figured it'd do us better
to come
and get some fresh air than to
stay cooped up in
the dorm!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I might be injured,
but I can still
train!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Racing, though... That's off the menu for
the time
being.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When are you hoping to make your
return?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I expect it will be difficult for
either of
us to
resume racing before the end of
the year...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I ran the Derby with everything I had,
fully
prepared for both my legs to
shatter. I've no
regrets at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But there is one thing I find rather
vexing... I
really would have liked to
have taken a shot at
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating that I can't compete, but
I'll just
cheer for you instead, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Do your very best in the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll make you both proud, I
promise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Learning how her rivals feel about being
unable to compete only bolsters Yaeno
Muteki's determination. This is going to
be a heated
summer camp for sure.
